run_training: run a PyTorch Lightning training loop with Hydra config and SLURM support
find_latest_slurm_ckpt: find the latest checkpoint file for a SLURM job to auto-resume training
set_up_slurm: set up SLURM auto-requeue and checkpoint symlinks for preemptible training jobs
instantiate_run_logger: instantiate a WandbLogger or TensorBoardLogger from a Hydra config for experiment tracking
instantiate_callbacks: instantiate PyTorch Lightning callbacks from config and update checkpoint dirpaths with run ID
